additional_info.subject: ID0449631-DC/Si-D/MY-[MP/ND 170000121] EVSE is not ready CRM:02889000623
additional_info.body:
Dear Amirul, good evening. I hope you are doing well.
I checked the logs from the previous 2 weeks and found:
The reason why you are receiving "evse is not ready" is due to someone pressing the emergency button.
The reason why you are receiving "secc pilot state is E" is due to a failed session, where the customer didn't present the authentication necessary to start it.
The reason why you see the Error on LEM meter is because of an incompatibility with certain EVs, in the upcoming v8.1, this is fixed, so when this version is available please request the update.
Let me know if you have any questions or I can close the ticket.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0449631-DC/Si-D/MY-[MP/ND 170000121] EVSE is not ready CRM:02889000623
additional_info.body:
Dear Amirul, good evening.
Thank you for the feedback and the list, this definitely helps me to provide you better information.
For the "ChargerOperationMode" it's the way the charger sends the notification that is currently booting up. On the logs I see this error right before the charger is up and running since it changed the OperationMode from booting up to Running
For the "modbus0 is not connected" it looks like the communication from the SECC to the PLC was lost for a short ammount of time and the "secc is offline" is the exact same behaviour
Both these errors have a fix in v8.0.5. I recommend to update it to that version.
For the "SafetyRelayQA26" it can only mean one of three different options:
Emergency button pressed
Reboot
Door opened
For the "secc is initializing" I checked the timestamp you provided and it seems that the SECC itself did a auto reboot and cause it to be unavailable for exactly 1 second. This will not occur during a charging session.
Please let me know if everything is answered to your needs and I can push the update or close the ticket.
Another question is, if you are not allowing the v8.0.5 to be installed, I can apply a hotfix instead of the full update.
I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco

necessary to start it.
The reason why you see the Error on LEM meter is because of an incompatibility with certain EVs, in the upcoming v8.1, this is fixed,
so when this version is available please request the update.
Let me know if you have any questions or I can close the ticket.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
